notes:
Summary: Enterprise code-assistant for regulated financial workflows. Primary ask: an IDE copilot that can run in our VPC or on-prem, stream token-by-token with <100ms median token latency in VSCode environment, and provide model/version pinning per-repo or per-team.

Key constraints / quotes: 
- "We cannot route PII outside our VPC — must be deployable into our private environment and integrate with Azure AD SAML." (Head of Infrastructure)
- Audit & retention: 7+ year immutable audit logs, searchable, exportable to Splunk; retention controls required.
- KMS / key control: customer-managed keys (bring-your-own) for model cache and logs.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency histograms, tracing hooks to map IDE session -> request.
- Model handling: ability to pin model versions for compliance (no silent upgrades), fallback policies to quantized runtime only when explicitly authorized.
- Throughput / scale: initially ~50 active devs in POC, target 500+ later; throughput requirement ~150 req/s for completions endpoint during peak.

POC plan: 6-week on-prem evaluation. Week 1: security sign-off + env provisioning. Week 2-3: integrate VSCode extension + streaming. Week 4: throughput/latency validation with synthetic traffic (50 concurrent). Week 5: audit log export test to Splunk. Week 6: final review and procurement handoff.
